Aug 2020 • Friends
I’ve got a meeting with old friends at Bup Sky Lounge Restaurant for lunch. Found out this nice resto when I read about it on Facebook. Located on 10th floor of the building, the lounge got a nice view with wide selection for lunch and a plus for great decor for food. 
We also enjoy each dish with its different taste and flavor. Its space is suitable for a nice talk since its peaceful & quiet.

One thing minus, since the weather is quite hot, air con should be on at its maximum level to create the comfort for customers. But if you enjoy the open air atmosphere, then who care :)

Last but not least, don’t forget to try their Mochi Ice cream which turned into my favorite if there is another chance for me to visit this Lounge again.
